notes.title: 🐺 Tribe of Werewolves is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2]📢 The Big Day is Here![/h2]

🎉 We are excited to announce: "Tribe of Werewolves" is now available on Steam! 🌕🐺 We are proud to bring this project we have been working on for a long time to you, our valued players.

⚔️ Step into the epic werewolf story with Tribe of Werewolves! Challenge enemies with your chosen character, experience unique gameplay with special weapons and magic combinations. Complete different quests on a massive map, uncover its hidden secrets, and prove your strength.

[h3]🕹️ Key Features:[/h3]

Legendary werewolf characters with unique weapons

Power-up combinations to create your own strategy

A deep gameplay experience that evolves over time

🛒 You can explore the game now on our Steam page and join this epic adventure!🔹 Click to visit the Steam Page

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156110/Tribe_of_Werewolves/

Don't forget to share your feedback with us when you play the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us!

🐾 Join your werewolf tribe, write your destiny! Thank you and have fun! 💙

notes.title: Tribe of Werewolves Launching on January 22nd!
notes.notes:
[h2]Ready to step into the world of Werewolves?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359323/46d6389f3f180e1e963caba289fcd2beda1a7208.png[/img]

We all have a hidden wild side deep within us, and now is the time to bring that dream to life! "Tribe of Werewolves" invites you into a dark adventure.

In this unique roguelike game, you will survive in a world ruled by werewolves and create your own tribal story. Choose from various characters, battle enemy packs, discover new weapons, and complete quests to test your power. Every choice will either make you a stronger warrior or face you with darker dangers.

[h3]What Do We Offer?[/h3]

[b]Strategic Choices:[/b] Create a personalized gameplay experience with upgrade options at each level.

[b]Dynamic Maps & Challenges:[/b] Conquer expansive maps with various enemies and quests to test your abilities.

[b]Evolving Weapons:[/b] Upgrade your chosen weapons and make them stronger with legendary combinations.

[b]Quests & Boss Fights:[/b] Complete difficult quests to defeat the strongest bosses and write your story.

[b]30 Minutes of Chaos:[/b] Race against time with a countdown clock ticking backward, and fight to survive.

Dive into this epic world full of werewolves, create your strategies, and fight to become the legendary leader of the werewolf tribe.

Join us and start writing your story. [b]"Tribe of Werewolves"[/b] is waiting for you!
